avis.titre: Easy to apply - not as moisturizing as I expected
avis.texte: Pros - very easy to apply, nice almost primer-like finish, easy to take on the go/to beach/airplane etc, applies decently over makeup, minimal scent, good price. However, since this is literally called "Moisturizing sun stick" and mentions a dewy finish, I really thought it would be, well, more moisturizing haha. It's not awful, don't get me wrong, and it would probably be really great for someone with oily skin, but I didn't perceive any moisturizing factor from this. Of course, that wasn't the primary reason I purchased it - this will absolutely be what I use for touch ups and to take the beach. I live in SW Florida and have been needing an easy touch-up sunscreen. I think my skin is a bit drier at the moment from hormones (am breastfeeding) and also because it's our dry season down here but still. I usually skip moisturizer in the morning and I actually felt like I had to use some with this. the finish reminds me more of a primer than a sunscreen - its VERY similar in feeling to the Pore-fessional prime by Benefit. Just smooth and semi-matte. It layers decently under makeup but I don't usually wear more than a tiny dab of concealer so I can't speak to whether or not this would sit nicely under a full face. All in all - I love Korean sunscreens and I will probably buy this again because like I said, it works well as an spf, especially for touch ups
The sun stick is not greasy. Feels nice on my skin. Very slight, pleasant scent. I haven't spent prolonged time in the sun yet so I can't comment on sun protection but SPF 50 should be good.
